lines.trans: An eighty-page English contract, and you finished reading it this fast?
No rush.
We have supervised four episodes of Entertainment Talk now, bringing it a fresh look.
Bu Xiaogu worked hard lately and put together a proposal that I think is quite good.
I guessed she was writing a proposal, yet I did not expect you to be involved too.
Who is the interview guest, being so demanding that this dragged on for four days?
I read the questions he raised; this person is a real expert.
The interview guests are Xin Huimei and the president of her fan club.
Why produce this interview episode? What trade did you make?
Nothing at all, boss; they set up a charity fund, and the topic is genuinely strong.
Keep the truth from me if you wish — you know my temper; tell that admin assistant outside she is not qualified to pitch.
